findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_receipt, list_receipts, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, read_my_inbox · Private data: pricing_conversation, compute_price, report_outcome, get_price_guardrails, set_price_guardrails, get_pricing_analysis, get_function, update_function, get_billing_settings, update_billing_settings, list_outcomes, get_usage, list_usage_events, get_receipt, list_receipts, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, read_my_inbox · Public sink: pricing_conversation, set_price_guardrails, update_function, update_billing_settings, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Destructive: compute_price, get_receipt, list_receipts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_receipt, list_receipts, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, read_my_inbox · Private data: pricing_conversation, compute_price, report_outcome, get_price_guardrails, set_price_guardrails, get_pricing_analysis, get_function, update_function, get_billing_settings, update_billing_settings, list_outcomes, get_usage, list_usage_events, get_receipt, list_receipts, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, read_my_inbox · Public sink: pricing_conversation, set_price_guardrails, update_function, update_billing_settings, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Destructive: compute_price, get_receipt, list_receipts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
